system.description:
Strange Check to make a plant do one thing: grow, restrain an enemy or NPC, move, or whisper its secrets to you. A CR 1 Strange Check lets you talk with animals. Doom +2 per successful use.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.64
system.summary: Strange Check to make a plant do one thing: grow, restrain an enemy or NPC, move, or whisper its secrets to you. A CR 1 Strange Check lets you talk with animals. Doom +2 per successful use.

automation.label: Plant: grow, move or whisper its secrets
automation.onSuccess: The plant does what you asked. Doom +2.

automation.label: Plant restrains a targeted enemy or NPC
automation.onSuccess: The plant restrains the target (Grappled). Doom +2.

automation.label: Talk with animals
automation.onSuccess: You can communicate with the animal. Doom +2.
